title: Numbers cheat sheet: tokens, cost and latency

cards.back: 1 token ≈ 4 characters ≈ ¾ of an English word. 1,000 words ≈ 1,300 tokens; one page ≈ 600 tokens.
Output costs 4 to 8 times more than input per token, so long answers are expensive and short labels are cheap.
Small about $0.10 in / $0.40 out, mid about $0.30 / $2.50, large about $1.25 / $10.

cards.front: Size of a chat turn with RAG
cards.back: About 5K tokens in (2K system prompt, 2K chunks, 1K history) and 250 out, about $0.002 on a mid model.
Every step re-sends the context, so an agent task is 30K to 100K tokens in. 8 steps take about 10 to 40 seconds.
100 to 300 tokens each, so 20 tools add about 4K tokens to every call.
Hindi, Tamil and other non-Latin scripts take 2 to 4 times the tokens of the same English text, so they cost more.
Batch mode is about 50% off; cached input is 75 to 90% off.
Requests per day × tokens per request × price per million, then × 30. Say every assumption out loud.

cards.front: Classifier vs LLM on fixed labels
cards.back: A classifier is 10 to 100 times cheaper and faster on high-volume fixed-label work: a few dollars vs $100+ per million items, 10 ms vs 1 s.
50 to 200 tokens per second, so a 300-token answer takes about 2 to 4 seconds; time to first token is 0.3 to 1 s.

quiz.q: Answering over a 100-page document: how does RAG with the top 5 chunks compare with sending it in full?
quiz.why: About 60K tokens in full vs about 5K with RAG: roughly $0.02 vs $0.002 on a mid model.

quiz.q: What is usually the biggest lever for cutting the LLM bill?
choices: A smaller model where evals allow
quiz.why: Routing or a cascade to a smaller model is often 5 to 10 times cheaper.

quiz.q: 1M items a day need fixed labels. What's usually the best interview answer?
choices: A large LLM for every item
A cascade: classifier for all, LLM for the ~10% it is unsure about
quiz.why: The cascade costs about $1K to $2K a month with a mid LLM and is mostly fast.

quiz.q: About how many tokens is one hour of audio?
quiz.why: Audio is about 30 tokens per second, so an hour is about 100K.

quiz.q: Support chat: 50K conversations × 6 turns × 5K in, 250 out. About what per month on a mid model?
quiz.why: 1.5B in and 75M out a day is about $640 a day, around $19K a month; large tier is about four times that.

quiz.q: Which cut applies to the fixed system prompt and tool definitions sent on every call?
quiz.why: Caching takes 75 to 90% off those repeated tokens.

quiz.q: What does a cross-encoder rerank of 50 chunks typically add?
quiz.why: Reranking 50 chunks takes about 50 to 200 ms; vector search is 10 to 50 ms.
